image_description: A close-up shot of a rectangular tin container with a blue and white speckled pattern. Two beige adhesive bandages are stuck to the front surface of the tin. The tin features red text at the top reading 'FALLIA' (or similar) and additional text at the bottom. The background is a solid purple color.
